description: This file defines the PHP class 'TemplateTextArea', a subclass of 'TemplateText', which is used within the SuiteCRM project to manage textarea field templates. It includes properties for rows, columns, and type, along with methods for setting values, generating detail view output, retrieving field definitions, and default database values.

classes.name: TemplateTextArea
classes.description: Represents a textarea field template in SuiteCRM, extending basic text field functionalities to include rows and columns configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextArea template, mapping 'rows' and 'cols' to specific vardefs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets properties from given values, including rows, columns, and default value from external variables.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Generates a detail view representation with line breaks for the textarea field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including any set rows and columns.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Provides a null default for database storage, since TEXT columns cannot have default values in MySQL.
